messages.图表指标必须为 value、change 或 change_pct。: Chart metric must be value, change or change_pct.
messages.change 和 change_pct 图表需要使用趋势模式。: Change and change_pct charts require trend mode.
messages.分析图表中的数值超出可绘制范围。: An analysis chart value exceeds the drawable numeric range.
messages.交互式分析图表最多支持 8 个系列和 500 个周期。: Interactive analysis charts support up to 8 series and 500 periods.
messages.交互式分析图表各系列的周期必须对齐。: Interactive analysis chart periods must align across series.
messages.交互式汇总图表最多支持 50 个分组。请缩小分组范围或导出 Excel。: Interactive summary charts support up to 50 groups. Narrow the grouping or export Excel.
messages.饼图和环形图需要一个系列。请选择一个对象或使用汇总分析。: Pie and doughnut charts require one series. Select one object or use a summary.
messages.饼图和环形图需要记录数或合计值。平均值或变化值请使用柱状图或折线图。: Pie and doughnut charts require count or sum values. Use a bar or line chart for averages or changes.
messages.饼图和环形图不能包含负值。请使用柱状图或折线图。: Pie and doughnut charts cannot contain negative values. Use a bar or line chart.
messages.组合图至少需要两个系列。请在趋势分析中选择两个或更多对象。: Combo charts require at least two series. Select two or more objects in a trend analysis.
messages.散点图需要数值分组字段。请使用汇总模式并按数值分组。: Scatter charts require a numeric grouping field. Use summary mode with numeric groups.
messages.散点图的分组值必须为数值。请选择数值分组字段。: Scatter chart group values must be numeric. Choose a numeric grouping field.
messages.散点图的分组值必须为有限数值。: Scatter chart group values must be finite numbers.
messages.图表类型必须为 auto、metric、line、bar、pie、combo、a: Chart type must be auto, metric, line, bar, pie, combo, area, scatter or doughnut.
messages.数值卡片需要一个整体汇总值。请取消分组，或使用图表展示多个结果。: A value card requires one overall summary value. Remove grouping or use a chart for multiple results.
messages.数值卡片需要一个聚合系列，且不能指定分组字段。: A value card requires one aggregate series and no grouping field.
